name: Hourly trend pullback buy (1h)
rationale: In a confirmed 1h uptrend (ADX high, positive medium return) a shallow RSI dip is a pullback, not a reversal: momentum traders take profits and value buyers step in at a discount before the trend resumes. The other side is the short-term profit-taker who sells the dip we buy. Edge persists because trend-following flows dominate the ignition but pause to rebalance, creating repeatable dip-buy windows. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX falls below the exit floor (trend has died) rather than a shallow pause.
catalyst: shallow oversold pullback inside a confirmed uptrend
